purpose: Bind the 21-operation authored reward envelope to the current Economy Admiral quest-reward valuation surface before any item reward is allowed to materialize.

economyAuthority.integrationMeaning: Economy Admiral now exposes a positive finite handbook-price lookup used by grouped quest-reward selection; Admiral can therefore fail closed on unpriced item rewards instead of approving qualitative item lists.

materializationChecklist: select the exact reward TPL only after the operation objective shape is proven on SPT 4.1.3
resolve every selected TPL through Economy Admiral handbook-price authority; missing or non-positive price rejects the item reward
for weapons, armor, helmets or rigs, prove all mandatory child slots/default inserts before valuation
sum direct RUB plus handbook-valued item rewards and compare the combined package to the operation risk-band ceiling
reject boss/Raider gear, rare-ammo, stim, key, container or capability-faucet rewards unless an explicit operation-specific exception survives Economy Admiral review
keep storefront/renewable unlock decisions separate from one-time reward valuation

currentWave.reason: The authored wave intentionally defaults to XP/RUB/standing. This contract removes ambiguity for later item-reward admission without changing the frozen runtime candidate or pre-approving any item.
